scholarships.name: International Merit Scholarship
scholarships.requirements: Must be an international student starting a full-time undergraduate degree; must be self-funding; academic excellence based on high school results (B-average or higher equivalent); automatic assessment upon application to the university.
scholarships.description: An automatic merit-based award designed to support talented international students. The scholarship provides a one-off £2,000 reduction in the first year of tuition fees to help students transition to life in Cambridge or Chelmsford.

scholarships.name: International Merit Scholarship
scholarships.requirements: Must be an international student starting a full-time postgraduate taught degree; must be self-funding; minimum 2:1 undergraduate degree or equivalent; automatic assessment at the point of admission.
scholarships.description: A one-off tuition fee reduction of £2,000 for international Master's students. This award is part of ARU's commitment to making global education more accessible for high-performing students across its business and technology faculties.
